title: MATH 3042 Statistics · Quiz 7
subtitle: This week's lab quiz: binomial and Poisson on paper, working with data in RStudio
description: A 98-minute drill shaped like the quiz: the announcement and the format, a pre-reading page for the calculator keys and the R basics, one short lesson per idea (binomial on paper, at least and at most, Poisson with a rescaled λ, the six data moves in RStudio, probabilities from a data frame with a printed conclusion, the d, p and r functions with a simulated check), two mock quizzes in the real two-part format, and a one-page know-cold sheet.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 7
**This week, in the lab session, 50 minutes.** Part 1 is paper and pencil with a calculator (10 marks); Part 2 is RStudio, knitting a notebook from the Learning Hub template to a Word file (10 marks). The announced topics: *Working with data in RStudio*, *Poisson distribution*, *Binomial distribution*. A probability is rounded to four decimal places; μ, σ and Z to two. No makeups.
:::
